sending_money_note: 3 ways: EFT through GTL/ConnectNetwork, JPay or Access Corrections (fee, posts in 1–3 days); JPay lock box by money order/personal check/cashier's check payable to JPay, mailed to JPay, 2202 South Figueroa St, Box #3001, Los Angeles, CA 90007 (no fee, max $999.99 per coupon, personal checks held 10 business days); or mail to the institution (no fee). Look up the CDCR number in CIRIS first.

ombudsman.name: CDCR Office of the Ombudsman
ombudsman.mail: California Department of Corrections and Rehabilitation, Office of the Ombudsman, P O Box 942883, Sacramento, CA 94283-0001
ombudsman.what: Independent, confidential intermediary for complaints and issues. Does not conduct formal investigations, change rules, or take part in grievance/hearing processes; cannot discuss specific medical treatment but can refer family concerns to health care staff.

reception_centers_note: CIM (Facility B), NKSP and WSP are stated as reception centers on their CDCR facility pages; CCWF (women) per a 2024 Inside CDCR article. todo: San Quentin's current reception status is not stated on its page.

institutions.name: California Correctional Institution
institutions.note: Original minimum facility deactivated September 2021; Facility D deactivated summer 2023 (CDCR closure page). Originally opened 1933 as a women's prison; now houses men. todo: current security levels not stated. Not described as a reception center on its CDCR facility page.

institutions.name: California Institution for Men
institutions.note: Facility B is the Reception Center (Reception Center Central). Facility D deactivated spring 2023 per CDCR closure page, though the facility page still describes a Facility D — treat housing details as possibly stale.

institutions.name: California Institution for Women
institutions.note: Mailing city is Corona, but CDCR says CIW is located in San Bernardino County (near Chino, Chino Hills and Eastvale). Facility page phone (909) 597-1772; List of Adult Institutions shows (909) 597-1771 — todo: confirm. Hub for female fire-camp training; higher-security housing for women in Administrative Segregation. Not described as a reception center on its CDCR facility page.

institutions.local_court: San Luis Obispo County Superior Court
institutions.note: Facility page address 'Colony Dr'; List of Adult Institutions shows 'Highway 1'. West Facility (Level I/II) deactivated winter 2023 per CDCR closure page. Not described as a reception center on its CDCR facility page.

institutions.name: California Rehabilitation Center
institutions.note: CLOSED. CDCR closure page: 'CDCR and CCHCS closed California Rehabilitation Center on Sept. 30, 2026' (2025–26 State Budget); the facility page banner says 'closed October 2026'. Still listed in the facility locator. People formerly at CRC were transferred to other institutions — look them up in CIRIS. Facility A was deactivated spring 2023.

institutions.name: Correctional Training Facility

fire_camps_note: CDCR lists 30 Conservation (Fire) Camps (25 with CAL FIRE, 5 with LA County Fire) plus the Ventura Training Center. Malibu (#13) and Puerta La Cruz (#14) are women's camps. Camps are not listed as institutions here; people in a camp show their camp in CIRIS. Many camps were deactivated in 2020–2023 (see closure page).

parole.note: Division of Adult Parole Operations (DAPO): parole offices, conditions, requirements, community resources, electronic monitoring, restitution and parolee voting info. Parole suitability hearings (lifers) are run by the Board of Parole Hearings.

local_court_note: local_court is simply the Superior Court of the county the prison sits in (county taken from the CDCR page where stated, otherwise from the facility's city). Confirm venue with counsel.
